title: Text API calls got simpler to make and authenticate
summary:
A garden-maintenance day: easier GET requests, clearer account guidance, more community projects, and one correctly versioned bot.

GET-based text generation now has a simplified endpoint and can accept tokens as query parameters. Frontend API keys are also visible and copyable, with full model access, while pk_ key authentication was repaired. Less ceremony between an idea and an HTTP request.

Tier benefits and product mappings were refreshed, auth.pollinations.ai users now see a migration notice, and the FAQ gained a payment-method voting link. Model cost information was also updated so the surrounding documentation better matches the machinery.

Four new community creations joined the Creative Projects list, while the description-condensing workflow was pointed at the correct debouncer version. One is inspiration; the other keeps automation from developing opinions.
